thread.title: Apple will report Q2 numbers May 1

author: InvestorsObserver
title: Apple will report Q2 numbers May 1
text:
Shutterstock photo What's Happening iPhone maker Apple ( AAPL ) will report its fiscal second-quarter numbers after the market close May 1. The company is expected to post earnings of $2.69 per share, up from $2.10 during the same period last year. The stock has had a volatile 2018, with shares now down 5.7% year to date.
Technical Analysis AAPL was recently trading at $162.41, down $21.09 from its 12-month high and $20.21 above its 12-month low. Overall technical indicators for AAPL are bullish with the stock showing signs of a possible trend reversal. The stock has recent support above $161.25 and recent resistance below $165.00. Of the 27 analysts who cover the stock, 13 rate it a "strong buy", 13 rate it a "hold", and one rates it a "strong sell". AAPL gets a score of 60 from InvestorsObserver's Stock Score Report.
Analyst's Thoughts Apple is fairly diversified across many tech sectors, but it is the iPhone that remains the primary driver of the company's fortunes. As is always the case, the stock will find its post-earnings direction mostly in reaction to the number of iPhones it sold during the quarter. Recently there have been fears that Apple will miss their iPhone estimate after a key chip supplier, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, lowered its sales guidance due to weaker than expected demand in the smartphone sector. This led to a big drop in AAPL shares, and analysts lowering their forecast for the quarter. Morgan Stanley followed the report by lowering its estimate for the quarter to 34 million iPhones sold, down from 40.5 million. On average, analysts had estimated that the company would sell around 43 million iPhones in the recent quarter. The good news for investors is that the lower expectations have already been priced into the stock, so while there is still downside risk on a bad quarter for the phone, the downside is somewhat limited, and there is a lot of upside potential should the actual number come in above estimates. Apple's earnings and sales will definitely play a role in determining the stock's fate after the report, but pay close attention to iPhone sales, as they will be the main driving factor.
Stock Only Trade If you're looking to establish a long stock position in AAPL, consider buying the stock under $162.50. Sell if it falls below $146.25 or take profits if it gets to $187.00. Bullish Trade If you want a bullish hedged trade on the stock, consider a June 135/140 bull-put credit spread for a 35-cent credit. That's a potential 7.5% return (56.1% annualized*) and the stock would have to fall 13.6% to cause a problem.
Bearish Trade If you want to take a bearish stance on the stock at this time, consider a June 180/185 bear-call credit spread for a $0.50 credit. That's a potential 11.1% return (82.8% annualized*) and the stock would have to rise 11.1% to cause a problem.
Covered Call Trade If you like the stock, but wish to lower your cost basis on a new position, you may want to consider a June $165 covered call. Buy AAPL shares (typically 100 shares, scale as appropriate), while selling the June $165 call for a debit of $157.40 per share. The trade has a target assigned return of 4.8%, and a target annualized return of 36.7% (for comparison purposes only).
